bio: Chef Paco Roncero, who is always pursuing new goals in line with his ‘never stop moving’ spirit, awaits you in a truly unique space, boasting an elegant, avant-garde aesthetic... on the top floor of a 19th-century building! Here, where there is also a spectacular terrace, you can enjoy a culinary experience in the form of three menus, all with wine pairing options: Esencia (more affordable and available Thursday and Friday lunchtime), Madrid, and, finally, the Gran Madrid.
